summary: Grifols SA filed a Form 6-K reporting half-year 2026 results, showing revenue of €3.6B (+2.6% cc) and net profit of €227M (+28.7%). The press release details operational performance, refinancing of 2027 maturities, and a €500M bond redemption. No special-situation event is involved; it is a routine earnings update with no M&A, activist, or restructuring triggers.
